note: Re-judged 2026-09-29. rfc7854_wire_header_test.go::TestRFC7854EveryTransmittedMessageCarriesVersion3AndItsTotalLength builds all seven types through the writers the sender calls (writeRouteMonitoring, writeStatisticsReport, writePeerDown, writePeerUp, writeInitiation, writeTermination, writeRouteMirroring) into a 0xA5-patterned buffer and requires octet 0 == 3 on each, so a writer that emits another version or leaves the octet unset goes red. The sentence binds the sender and no input can make it send another version; the negatives (header_test decode table #2, session_test TestBMPMalformedHeaderDrops) are the receiver refusing a version-2 header, the same rule read at the other end. The old decode-table positive stays tagged and proves only decode.
